speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Please describe the characteristics of your longstanding pruritic rash on your palms, such as its color, texture, and distribution. Also, can you tell me if the numbness and tingling in your hands are constant or do they come and go?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Porphyria Cutanea Tarda (PCT) secondary to chronic arsenic exposure. The patient's history of working on a rice farm and caring for livestock, combined with a chronic blistering rash on sun-exposed areas (upper body and face) and neuropathy, is highly suggestive of PCT triggered by arsenic toxicity. Arsenic is commonly used as a soil amendment in rice cultivation and can cause both dermatologic and neurologic symptoms. Further testing will be required to confirm this diagnosis.
